svg.text: Live task time, summed over the checkpoint (seconds)
exact-trace savings measure the read backend only — a sliver of task time, not end-to-end speedup
Total 5,691s across live H1 runs. Read-trace savings (median 1.4s/trace on 51 replays) sit inside the "everything else" slice.
Candidate-A era, 12-task checkpoint rerun — not rc2, not a task-time claim.
